findings.text: resolve_section_routing has no production caller, so a live dispatch cannot name the raise the goal promises; the manifest declares the wiring as a follow-on because reckon/crew/dispatch.py was claimed by a concurrent node, and the landed half is the rule plus an entry point nothing calls.

the record-identity derivation is a fourth implementation beside routing.py:1189, dispatch.py:245 and promotion.py:1870, and promotion.py maps a dotted reference to s5-1 where this one returns s5.1; a spelling the helper does not cover makes _section_record return {} at :214, so attempts read as None and the section silently never raises.

the regenerated module's ruff surface grows by nine UP045 findings (115 at base, 124 at head) because gen-pydantic emits Optional[...] per new optional slot, while the manifest's ruff claim names the three hand-written staged files only; only scripts/regen_flight_schema.py can remove them without breaking byte-identity regeneration.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against 99455576; c23de221 adds the rule, the class overlays and the resolution entry point, 11d097c4 regenerates both artefacts from their source, 48128dc0 writes the plan record and the anchor, and 856c3605 corrects them against the committed head.
item_verdicts.done_when: the named measure is a fixture record at attempts 3 resolving to the raised backend with the raise and its count named, and the same record at 2 resolving unraised and naming nothing; tests/test_section_attempts_capability.py:153 and :184 assert exactly those two arms through resolve_section_routing.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is a raise keyed to a section's attempt count that the dispatch names; reckon/crew/routing.py:217 capability_raise and :263 resolve_section_routing land the rule and a summary carrying the count, but no production caller reaches them.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the six-case file passing at 11d097c4, the matched head and base arms over the 47 measured files, the regeneration idempotence and the declared negative control, each with a durable log under the run directory.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest's ten declared paths cover every path the diff touches; git diff --name-only 99455576..856c3605 lists the same ten and nothing else.

justifications.durability: the declared control removes the rule and the attempts-3 arm fails at tests/test_section_attempts_capability.py:162 on assert 'section-lane' == 'raised-lane'; the payload attempts read-back at :161 would also hold under a constant-count regression, and it is the :184 arm at attempts 2 that discriminates it.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_section_attempts_capability.py:162 asserts the raised backend and :245 asserts the threshold came from the shipped default layer, and the file fails at base 99455576 on assertions and schema validation rather than collection, so the gate discriminates the change.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/routing.py:194 adds a fourth section-identity spelling beside routing.py:1189, dispatch.py:245 and promotion.py:1873, whose dotted-reference form disagrees with it, and reckon/_flight_schema.py carries 124 ruff findings against 115 at base, all UP045 from the generator's Optional emission.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/routing.py:263 resolve_section_routing is the only code that applies the raise and no production module calls it — reckon/crew/dispatch.py:2992, :3364 and :3480 resolve through resolve_role without a capability class — so the goal's second limb, the dispatch naming the raise, is not true of any reachable dispatch yet.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff 99455576..856c3605 changes exactly the ten declared paths, leaves plan-version 30 and plan-modified 2026-09-26 untouched, and extends the cumulative evidence metas without dropping any of the thirteen anchors present at base.
